name: browser-automation-studio.author-flow
purpose: Validate a draft V2 flow object, execute it once ad hoc, and report whether it is persistable into the candidates folder; never marks an unvalidated or failing draft persistable.

flow.description: The V2 flow definition object (metadata, nodes, edges). Required unless ai_prompt is given, in which case the program reports the AI path unavailable.

ai_prompt.description: AI generation prompt. Reported no_governed_binding: `workflows create --ai-prompt` has no binding.

name.description: Label for the ad hoc execution and the suggested workflow name.

assumptions: browser-automation-studio is running and its playwright-driver is ready
the CLI flag --flow-file is CLI-local; in-kernel the flow is passed as the proto field `workflow` (validate) and `flow_definition` (execute-adhoc), verified live 2026-09-02
workflows/create has no governed binding, so persistence is a CLI step the envelope names in signals.persist_command
invariants: the draft is validated before any execution
exactly one ad hoc execution per submission; no retry
persistable is true only after validate returned valid and the ad hoc execution completed
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

status.note: "ok" is unreachable: workflows/create has no governed binding, so a validated, once-executed draft is reported partial with persistable=true and persist_command. Re-add ok when the binding exists.

signals.persistable: true only when validation passed and the ad hoc run completed
signals.persist_command: the CLI command that persists the draft into the folder

budget.async_reason: wall_ms exceeds the 120 s synchronous bound: submit with --async and wait once.

inputs.ai_prompt: open the dashboard and screenshot it

fixtures.note: A validated, once-executed draft is the best outcome available: workflows/create has no governed binding, so the program reports partial with persistable=true and the persist command. Tighten to ok when that binding exists.
